notes.title: Introducing KillStreak.tv!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32204839/d74f2c0e6d839734f60cfe7b80fa4aab85881216.jpg

Hey Blue Wizard fans! We are proud to announce that the online multiplayer bullet-battling gameshow, KillStreak.tv is making its official Steam debut! Hop on over to the Steam store and download KillStreak.tv for FREE today!

KillStreak.tv is a fast-paced 'Free for All' online multiplayer third-person shooter. Jump in different arenas, defeat your opponents using a range of customizable weapons, and look good doing it with character customization and tons of unlockable gear.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32204839/3a6e9256929fc15f11393a53c46f21216353cf28.jpg

Key Features:

 Fast-paced shooting action: Run 'n gun, improve your score and rewards with kill streaks
 Three arena levels to play in: Warehouse Warfare, Bar Room Brawl & Carpark Carnage
 Earn Kill Coins to unlock new Items: Including weapons, hats, heads and costumes
 Earn XP for equipped gear: Level items up to unlock new Skins and Mods
 Tons of Skins and Mods available for each Item, with more content coming soon...


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1053060/KillStreaktv/

notes.title: F13KP Patch Notes - v1.6.4
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32204839/141c0c7d2e4698c39a3425aec81d069146494994.gif

Hey Slayers! We've had an incredible launch week and already have over 2 MILLION PLAYERS slashing their way through Camp Crystal Lake and beyond! We've updated the game on Steam with a new version that includes a handful of bug fixes and optimizations. Feel free to get in touch (support@bluewizard.com) if you notice anything strange while you're running the game and we can be sure it gets dealt with as quickly as possible in a future update!

Here's a quick rundown on what you can find in the 1.6.4 Patch:

 Found those missing DLC Jason weapons -- check here for info on restoring them
 Resolved a save game issue
 Tidied up some visual content & bugs
 Fixed the Lucky Number 13 achievement
 Squashed some bugs involving puzzle solutions
 Fixed a bug where rewinding caused music to stop playing
 Fixed several minor ui bugs
 Fixed bug with Steam Controller Support -- should now be functional!


Thanks so much for making this an incredible launch for us! Your positive feedback and excitement has been keeping us going strong. Thank you so much for the kind and thoughtful reviews — keep em coming!!

Cheers,
The Blue Wizards :slayawayknife:
